title: 第十九章 模拟意识高阶AI大脑进化第二十章 化劲宗师
content_zh:
魔都大学的化学系内容拥有从基础化学到高等化学的全系教学科目。
林夜直接选了一堆。
《有机化学a》、《无机化学与化学分析实验》、《物理化学》...
“物理化学...我倒是还能提前接触一下物理学了。”
他抱起书本，寻找了一处空位。
魔都大学不缺天才，更不缺努力的天才，所以即便是晚上十点，依旧是灯火通明。
这里面既有本校的学生和考研生，也有从其他学校考过来的考研生。
所有人都是为了获取知识，考研，继而获取更为体面的工作，更好的前程未来。
有人甚至每天苦学到凌晨两三点才回去休息。
只有林夜，是单纯怀抱着对知识的渴望。
他快速吸收着化学知识，随着知识吸收，许多能力也就在脑海中自动构思，冥冥之中，他似乎是来到了一个既由化学符号组成，又由各种操作画面组成的知识海洋。
“这是...？”
林夜忽的一惊，但很快便反应过来。
“随着脑力提升，我的大脑又多出了一些新的能力，已经可以在脑海中完成操作模拟实验？就像ai一样？
如果是这样，我可以节省很多时间啊！”
譬如...他通过不断模拟试错，一遍又一遍，极短时间内就能把自己的操作水平提升到大师级，这样等到自己真正去做实验的时候，就不会像个新手一样还要慢慢训练提升。
这种方法本身是有一个极大弊端的，那就是脑力再强，肉身神经不够发达，也无法完美执行大脑命令。
就像很多人觉得自己可以做到某些事，真去做了就发现实际和想象中差的太远。
但林夜早就把肉身修为提升，导致神经系统也要远远超过普通人，可以很好的衔接并完成大脑指令，这个缺点也随之解决。
拓展思维则让他想到另一个事情，这还可以用在武学上。

他现在只是空有修为在身，即所谓的一力破万法。
杀黄海也是如此，并不是什么高深技巧，纯粹是自己的实力超出他太多太多。
可一旦自己遇到一位和自己实力相同的存在，譬如另一位暗劲高手，自己就太吃亏了。
哪怕有精神沟通略作干扰，那种级别的强者应该也能很快反应过来，并以强大的战斗技巧在极短时间内对自己造成致命性威胁。
自己在脑海中不断模拟战斗，就像训练ai大数据库一样，不断喂数据，不断精进自己。
他将会掌握暗杀、正面对抗、近身格斗、甚至是...躲避子弹？
“也许我还能用在后续进阶路线演化，以及打造热武器上面。”
拿热武器来打比方，制作一件热武器需要专家做出设计图纸，并将各种数据纳入其中，继而打造出现实武器，然后再进行实战实验。
导弹、战机需要风洞，炮弹、子弹需要爆炸数据...
那些东西都是由联邦把控的，林夜除非加入联邦效力，而且即便是加入效力，也要饱受钳制才能接触这些机密，付出的代价太大太大。
现在，他只需要将数据一键带入大脑，就可以直接模拟出来效果，不仅可以避免很多错误路线，避免被联邦发现，还能节省海量金钱。
这模拟意识简直就是一个神技。
“那个...这位同学，你好。”
就在林夜正思考和喜悦之时，一道突如其来的声音打断了他。
林夜抬头看去，入眼的是一个青年，长相端正，穿的衣服虽然普通，不过气质很好。
此人家境应该不差，林夜第一时间在心底给出评判。
“有什么事吗？”
林夜淡淡开口，对方微笑道：
content_en:
The Department of Chemistry at Modu University has a full range of teaching subjects from basic chemistry to advanced chemistry.
Lin Ye directly chose a bunch.
"Organic Chemistry A", "Inorganic Chemistry and Chemical Analysis Experiments", "Physical Chemistry"...
"Physical Chemistry... I can still get in touch with physics in advance."
He picked up the book and looked for an empty space.
There is no shortage of geniuses in Shanghai University, let alone those who work hard, so even at ten o'clock in the evening, the lights are still bright.
There are both students from our school and postgraduate candidates, as well as postgraduate candidates from other schools.
Everyone is here to gain knowledge, take postgraduate entrance exams, and then get a more decent job and a better future.
Some people even work hard every day until they go back to rest at two or three in the morning.
Only Lin Ye had a simple desire for knowledge.
He quickly absorbed chemical knowledge. As he absorbed the knowledge, many abilities were automatically conceived in his mind. Somewhere in the background, he seemed to have arrived at an ocean of knowledge composed of both chemical symbols and various operation pictures.
"Is this...?"
Lin Ye was suddenly startled, but quickly reacted.
"With the improvement of my brain power, my brain has gained some new abilities. I can already complete operational simulation experiments in my mind? Just like AI?
If so, I can save a lot of time! "
For example... through constant simulation and trial and error, over and over again, he was able to improve his operating level to a master level in a very short period of time. This way, when he actually does the experiment, he won't be like a novice who has to slowly train and improve.
This method itself has a huge drawback, that is, no matter how strong the brain is, the physical nerves are not developed enough and cannot perfectly execute the brain's commands.
Just like many people think they can do something, but when they actually do it, they find that reality is far from what they imagined.
However, Lin Ye had long since improved his physical body, resulting in a nervous system that was far superior to that of ordinary people. It could well connect and complete brain instructions, and this shortcoming was also solved.
Expanding his thinking made him think of another thing, which could also be used in martial arts.
Now he only has the cultivation base in his body, which is the so-called breaking all laws with one force.
The same goes for killing Huang Hai. It's not a profound skill, it's just that his own strength exceeds him by far.
But once he encounters a being with the same strength as himself, such as another dark power master, he will be at a huge disadvantage.
Even if there is a slight interference in spiritual communication, a strong man of that level should be able to react quickly and use his powerful combat skills to pose a fatal threat to himself in a very short time.
I constantly simulate battles in my mind, just like training an AI database, constantly feeding data and constantly improving myself.
He will master assassination, head-on confrontation, close combat, and even... dodging bullets?
"Perhaps I can also use it in the subsequent evolution of the advanced route and the creation of thermal weapons."
Taking the analogy of thermal weapons, making a thermal weapon requires experts to make design drawings and incorporate various data into them, then create a realistic weapon, and then conduct actual combat experiments.
Missiles and fighter planes need wind tunnels, and artillery shells and bullets need explosion data...
Those things are controlled by the federation. Unless Lin Ye joins the federation, and even if he joins the federation, he will have to be suppressed to access these secrets. The price paid is too high.
Now, he only needs to bring the data into his brain with one click, and he can directly simulate the effect. Not only can he avoid many wrong routes and be discovered by the federation, but he can also save a huge amount of money.
This simulated consciousness is simply a magical skill.
"Um... hello, classmate."
Just when Lin Ye was thinking and happy, a sudden voice interrupted him.
Lin Ye looked up and what caught his eye was a young man with a handsome face.Yes, although the clothes he wears are ordinary, his temperament is very good.
This person's family background should not be bad, Lin Ye immediately made a judgment in his heart.
"What's the matter?"
